purpose: Prevent obsolete pull-request workflow runs from consuming runner/concurrency capacity after a PR head moves, without cancelling production, current-head, scheduled, push, workflow_run or workflow_dispatch work.
safetyLaw: A run is cancellable only when it belongs to the same pull request and same PR head branch, is a pull_request event, is not completed, and its head SHA differs from the current PR head SHA.
Runs on main are never cancellable by this controller.
Current-head runs are never cancellable by this controller.
Production writers remain serialized by their own truth-plane concurrency contracts.
The controller reduces obsolete queue work; it does not weaken or skip any current-head domain check.
